description: This file contains utility functions for locating string resource folders in an Android project, parsing a Crowdin YAML configuration, and filtering directories based on naming conventions.

methods.name: isValidStringResourceFolderName
methods.description: Checks if a folder name matches the pattern for valid string resource directories, such as 'values' or 'values-xx'.

methods.name: locateStringResourcesFoldersInRes
methods.description: Finds string resource folders within a given resource directory, filtering by valid naming conventions.

methods.name: locateStringResourcesFolders
methods.description: Reads a Crowdin YAML configuration file and locates all associated string resource folders in the project.
